changes.title: Navigating trail map points
changes.description:
It is now easier to move through the points of a trail map. When any point is clicked, this will bring up a
'ping card' of information. On this card you can now reach the start and end points of the trail data (using
the double arrows << >>) and all points in between (using the single arrows < >).
